reason: Both correctly tie 22E to the fridge/evaporator fan with likely ice build-up and both land on a safe unplugged full defrost, but Conversation 1 gets there in three efficient turns, correctly reads the ticking/scraping noise as the fan hitting ice, specifies 24-48h with ice packs for food, and clearly sets out the escalation path: if 22E returns it points to a defrost heater/thermostat or fan motor fault needing an engineer. Conversation 2 repeats the same boilerplate paragraph three times, sends the customer looking at the freezer back wall despite the customer twice saying the frost is on the fridge side, asks a listening check the customer could not perform, overstates that freezer food will be 'perfectly safe' in a cool box for 24 hours, and never explains what to do if the code recurs. Neither raised warranty, and Conversation 1's stray 'sealed system' image note is a minor blemish, but Conversation 1 served the homeowner more honestly and efficiently.
